title: iOS 1.17 — Departure and arrival airport cards
body:
- Departure and arrival airport cards on the Observed tab: the flight category now and at your departure or arrival time, any TEMPO/PROB period, visibility, cloud and weather, wind with the runway and crosswind, nearby storm cells and lightning, and the TAF timeline. Side by side on iPad, stacked on iPhone.
- The Cells list now matches the alerts and the website: storms ahead of you in route order, then those behind, with their position, closing speed and when they'll be abeam. Tap one to see it on the map.
- Late take-off: once you've pressed Start, tracking and live updates stay on if you leave later than planned, up to six hours.
- A banner tells you when you're looking at saved data or have no connection.
- Fixes: a round trip is no longer marked as landed the moment you press Start.
